tabs.tab_title: Will you attend events for me?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] We plan, promote and support them. You and your team are the faces people should meet.

tabs.tab_title: How do you measure local marketing?
tabs.tab_content: Partner referrals, local search visibility, event leads and mentions, tracked in your monthly report.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need to sponsor things?
tabs.tab_content: Not necessarily. Many of the best local ties are partnerships that cost little more than time.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Local Ties on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because local ties works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
